scope: One Node file (built-in modules only; tested on Node 24) that runs a command with its own short temporary directory as TMPDIR and removes it on exit or signal, with a test file of eight offline tests. No dependencies, fonts or images are bundled. Earlier component approvals do not apply.

source.name: temp-root-runner (extracted from a private repository; the public files were stripped of project-specific names and carry no history)

not_imported: project-specific names, paths and issue numbers

derivations.temp-root.mjs: Generalised from a private test-runner helper: the keep switch renamed to KEEP_TEMP_ROOT, a command-line entry added, organisation wording removed.
